authorScope: Single bounded body-free author attempt with an authorized fixed-fact supplement
revisionRecord: An initial draft/journal/seal was written before clarification.md authorization arrived; the same three outputs were replaced to incorporate the authorized supplement. No source review occurred.

provided: ExecutionShellSelection has dialect, display, source, and optional string id, label, path.

saveSessionEntry returns Promise<unknown>; sessionEntries returns Promise<Array<{data: unknown}>>.

inferred: SessionId supports string concatenation for the specified entry ID.
The provided existing dependency declarations will accept the entry structure and warning fields required by the contract.

limitations: No source, history, tests, oracles, lineage, status, team context, or broader repository inspection.

Hashes were computed from the exact UTF-8 bytes held in memory and then written; output files were not reread.
